item: A3a — deterministic draft from a teach session: IR fields the cited clauses determine

hardware.NOT_the_published_bench_machine: V02_REPORT.md and BASELINES.md figures were measured on 2 vCPU Xeon (AVX-512) / 8 GB. Nothing here may be merged with those.

acceptance_criterion: session -> IR with every field the clauses determine filled and every other field marked hypothesis or issue, with no model call

chain.model_calls_note: A3a is deterministic by construction: it reads values off clause text and enumerates alternatives it will not choose between. Choosing is A3b's job and needs the model bundle.

what_the_document_determines_on_its_own.reading: 6 of 22 field states are evidence. The draft does not compile and says so: that is the honest outcome of a deterministic pass, not a failure of it. The 16 questions are what a model, or the expert, has to answer.

segmentation_bridge.finding: A1 splits clauses at . ; : ! ? so a citation is a span a human can check, which puts 'Step 1 validity:' in a different clause from the numbers it heads. The claim extractors need the whole sentence. Cited clauses are therefore rejoined in document order and re-split at sentence ends, and each claim unit records the clause ids it came from so a claim stays traceable to the citations the expert chose.

examples_not_scored.why: NOT_MEASURED: the examples cannot be evaluated against an IR that does not compile. C1 scores them once the expert has answered the questions. This is not zero agreement.

artifacts.retained: no (temporary working directory; rerun to reproduce)
